fixes.explanation: God says to sound the horn “…on the tenth day of the seventh month, the Day of Atonement.” (Leviticus 25:9) Seven times seven years, forty-nine of them, and then THE HORN. I think that's the loudest alarm clock anybody ever got, and nobody's hitting snooze on it. It goes “…far and wide…” and it's the signal for the fiftieth year, the Jubilee.

You got it, baker! God says to help him “…as you would a foreigner or stranger, so that he can continue to live among you.” (Leviticus 25:35) The goal is that he keeps living right there with his people. I think that means the help is meant to come while he's still standing in the neighborhood, not after. The command is simple: help him.
